branches: Classify Current Issue State (model-driven): SUP-4102 resolved → Customer Satisfaction Agent (expected Positive → Ask For Feedback Message → Close Issue); SUP-4117 pending more information → Last Message is Not Bot true → Issue Reminder Agent → Send Reminder; SUP-4123 still waiting → KnowledgeBase Agent
Solution Found? (model-driven): true expected for SUP-4123 (KB article and a Done issue answer it) → Reply to Issue → Close Issue2; false would go Notify Slack Channel → Reply to Issue
Customer Satisfaction Agent outputs: Positive (Ask For Feedback Message), Neutral (Add Autoclose Message), Negative (Report Unhappy Resolution)
expect.offline: Execute Workflow runs this same workflow ($workflow.id, mode each) from the Execute Workflow Trigger once per issue, so the bench must activate or save the workflow; Execute Workflow itself is not a read (validate may warn). The Jira credential needs a domain (bench credential). Close Issue/Close Issue2 send statusId 31 (Done) as a transition; no reply is read
